_doc: Hunter RL track. Hunter is ranged + a pet that holds aggro (Growl), so it survives better than the mage once a pet exists — weight death/damageTaken lighter than mage but still ranged-fragile early (no pet pre-L? tame). Reward kill+xp throughput (pet damage and pet kills credit the owner) while penalizing time. The env (headless/env_server.ts) applies these rewards server-side; train_agent.py / run_env.mjs pass them in env.reset(). curriculum stages run until untilLevel.
